title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-27
lineage: Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkII) -> Apogee MiniMe (24bit/48k) -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC/16
taper: Cassettes provided by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton

ai_review.summary: Incredible New Year's show captured from Joani’s MSC tapes; recording sounds great and the band is smoking hot with standout Black Peter.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this late‑December ’82 performance, calling it “incredible” and noting that the Dead are always smokin’ around New Year’s. The tape, sourced from Joani Walker’s MSC recordings, is praised for sounding excellent despite limited technical detail. Highlights include a solid Black Peter and strong overall energy.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic reviews (5★ and 3★) praise the show’s energy and recording quality, outweighing a neutral 0★ comment; combined show and tape assessment yields an overall four‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Taped from Joani Walker’s MSC source; no specific flaws mentioned, listeners describe the sound as “incredible.”

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments, but reviewers note the typical strong New Year’s set flow and overall cohesiveness.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned as bringing “the Persian love,” implying a memorable guitar moment.
